FYI — I pulled the logs from the Coupa integration:
- Envelope-from: no-reply@redwood-svc.com
- Sending IPs: 34.209.112.45, 34.209.112.46 (AWS SES pool we use for transactional)
- DKIM: passing (selector rwd1), SPF: neutral due to third-party relay
- Message was sent as multipart/alternative with HTML that includes tracking params and a short redirect (our usual flow).

Workaround options I recommend:
1) Re-send a minimal, text-only invite from support@redwood.com (manual send) so their MX doesn't see HTML tracking.
2) Generate a one-time direct accept URL from Coupa and send via DM (less likely to be rewritten).
3) Provide the raw .eml (Laura can export) so their IT can inspect headers when whitelisting.

Markus — is there any risk sending a manual invite from support@redwood.com? I know we prefer the integration for auditability but this is blocking acceptance and PO issuance.

-Ben
